In Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed, it looks up `embed_by_username` and `return if user.blank?` (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:25-26), and TopicRetriever#fetch_http does the same (lib/topic_retriever.rb:49-50).
